title: Book One · Chapter 18: A Place to Try
story:
The school yard is shut on Monday afternoon. There is a note on the gate. People are cleaning the ground inside.

Leo reads the first part. Ronan reads the last word. They read the note together. Then they stop pulling the handle.

"Can we try the road?" Leo asks.

A handcart comes round the corner just then. Its long handles take up most of the road. Both boys step back beside Mum.

"That's why we can't," she says.

The green yard is too small. The kite tail can catch on the washing line. There is a wire above the roof. Mum tells them to stay off the roof, too.

Ronan walks with the kite flat against his chest. He puts the long tail over his shoulder. He does not let it touch the ground.

Near River Street, an old man is putting pencils into a glass jar. His stall stands under a narrow roof. There are exercise books in neat piles and a small red chair behind the board.

"Is that a kite or a new coat?" he asks.

"A kite," Leo says. "It doesn't work."

"Doesn't fly yet," Ronan says quickly.

The old man nods. "That's a different answer."

Mum often sees him at this stall. She asks about an open place nearby.

"Mr Qiu," she says to the boys. "He keeps this stall."

Mr Qiu points toward the back of the street. "There is an old drying yard. On some afternoons, it is empty. Ask the people there first. They use it for carts too."

"Do you make kites?" Ronan asks.

"I used to. Now I run and my knees hurt."

"You can stand still. We run."

Mr Qiu laughs. "Then I may be able to help."

He cannot leave the stall. He tells them that at once. A customer is coming for a packet of chalk, and he has to be there.

"But bring it here tomorrow. I can look at the string. Not during my busy half hour."

"When isn't busy?" Leo asks.

"After your school lets out, wait a little. Everybody wants a pencil at the same time."

They go with Mum to see the drying yard. It is behind a row of small shops. A woman is taking empty baskets off the ground. Mum speaks to her. The woman points to the far half. They can use that part. The gate must be open. An adult must come with them. A cart may come into the yard. Then the boys must stop.

The woman points to the swept side. "Keep out of the broken corner. There are bits of tile."

Ronan looks at the ground first. He keeps the kite in his hands. He finds a smooth place near the wall. There is room to walk in a straight line.

They only try twice. The kite falls both times. Leo wants one more go, but a cart wheel appears at the gate.

Ronan picks up the tail. Mum calls Leo to the side. The driver thanks them and pushes the cart through.

They wait until the cart is past. The driver uses this yard, too. Ronan looks at the gate and broken corner. His plan does not show those yet.

At home, he draws the yard beside the kite picture. He adds the gate, the safe half, and a little picture of Mum.

"Very tall," she says.

"We need you there."

"Then give me somewhere to sit."

He draws a chair. It is the best chair he has drawn all week.
studyGuide:
---

重点表达：nearby＝附近；safe＝安全的；yard＝院子；tile＝瓦片。

理解问题：

1. 为什么小院和马路都不适合试风筝？
2. Mr Qiu 给他们提供了什么帮助和限制？
